comment: netty-handler still resolves to a stale 4.1.130.Final even with netty-bom:4.2.17.Final imported above (something nearer in the Spark/Hadoop dependency tree pins it independently of the bom); pinned explicitly to the same 4.2.17.Final line as netty-bom/netty-all so it doesn't fall back to an inconsistent 4.1.x version - CVE-2026-44249, CVE-2026-45416, CVE-2026-50010, CVE-2026-75595

CVE-2026-18401 (the module-local com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-core dependency, correctly resolved per the shade-plugin log - CVE-2025-52999 and GHSA-r7wm-3cxj-wff9 are a separate finding, see the parquet-jackson entry below)

CVE-2026-54514, CVE-2026-54515, CVE-2026-59888, CVE-2026-50193, CVE-2026-68497, CVE-2026-83557, CVE-2026-19032 (the module-local com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind dependency, correctly resolved per the shade-plugin log - CVE-2026-54512 and CVE-2026-54513 are a separate finding, see the parquet-jackson entry below)

org.apache.parquet:parquet-jackson (pulled in transitively via Spark/Hadoop's Parquet support) is a shaded jar that relocates its own internal Jackson copy under shaded.parquet.com.fasterxml.jackson.* but leaves non-relocated META-INF/maven/com.fasterxml.jackson.core/{jackson-core,jackson-databind}/pom.properties metadata behind, which SBOM tooling attributes as a direct com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-core:2.13.4 / jackson-databind:2.13.4.2 dependency (CVE-2025-52999, GHSA-r7wm-3cxj-wff9, CVE-2026-54512, CVE-2026-54513) even though those classes are not the real, loadable Jackson classes used elsewhere in the build (those correctly resolve to 2.21.6 - see the jackson-core/jackson-databind entries above). parquet-jackson 1.18.1 embeds jackson-core/-databind 2.22.2 internally, which clears the stale metadata; this Spark job never reads/writes Parquet files itself, so the 5-minor-version jump in a library this application never exercises carries negligible functional risk

org.lz4:lz4-java:1.8.1 is a Maven relocation stub (<distributionManagement><relocation><groupId>at.yawk.lz4) - the project moved groupId at that exact version, Maven follows it automatically, and dependencyManagement re-applies after relocation, so this pin plus the at.yawk.lz4 entry below resolve together to the at.yawk.lz4 version. CVE-2025-12183

the relocation target for org.lz4:lz4-java above (same net.jpountz.lz4 packages, same upstream author) - this is the version that actually lands in the shaded jar. CVE-2025-66566, CVE-2026-59949 both have real fixes on this coordinate (1.10.1 and 1.11.1 respectively) unlike org.lz4:lz4-java which has no fix for CVE-2025-66566. The shaded jar's own maven-shade-plugin config only protects org.lz4:* from minimizeJar (not at.yawk.lz4:*, the coordinate this actually resolves to post-relocation), so the cassandra/elasticsearch module POMs also need an at.yawk.lz4:* shade filter - see the pom.xml patch step below
